public_rationale: The categorical customer-price component is contradicted on the ordinary unit-price reading. Anthropic announced a threefold reduction in fast-mode pricing on May 28, before the post. This finding does not settle the broader assertions about sustainable business models, provider costs or economic value. If cheaper instead means total spending on expanding workloads, the evidence does not resolve that reading.
limitations: The contradiction concerns one explicit component of the bundled claim.
One service's price reduction does not establish an industry-wide decline in average prices.
The result depends on distinguishing unit prices from aggregate expenditure.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI does not have a business model, is not a tool with value remotely commensurate with its costs, and is not getting cheaper for providers or customers.

statement.excerpt: Generative AI does not have a business model. It is not a tool with value remotely commensurate with its costs. It isn’t getting cheaper for the providers or the customers.

our_interpretation: In context, no business model means no economically sustainable way to sell the service, rather than literally no pricing mechanism.
The ordinary testable reading of getting cheaper includes lower customer prices for comparable service. Aggregate spending can increase while unit prices decline.
Because no period is named, I use May 2026, the latest completed calendar month before publication, for the ongoing customer-price observation.

The three assertions are assessed as a conjunction. A clear counterexample to the categorical customer-price assertion contradicts that component without settling the broader value and sustainability judgments.
This is a sector-wide economic assertion, not a specified company's financial metric.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer prices and provider costs show no decline, and credible economic evidence supports the asserted absence of sustainable value relative to costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented reduction in customer prices for comparable generative-AI service contradicts the categorical customer-price component; demonstrated sustainable economics could separately contradict the business-model component.
